$comment: Single source of truth for GitHub Actions secrets and variables (NAMES and metadata only — never values). Reusable across repos. Update this file in the same PR that adds a secret/variable, plus .env.example and the workflow.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.scope: single purpose: administrative assistant only; never used by booking logic
secrets.notes: Optional. Without it the assistant is disabled and booking still works. Runtime value lives in Apps Script Script Properties; this GitHub copy is only for the gated live smoke test.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.scope: fallback LLM provider slot in Llm.gs LLM_CHAIN
secrets.notes: Declared so the name is reserved; do NOT add a PROVIDERS entry until the live smoke test exists for it.

validation.hint: optional: reserved for the fallback provider

secrets.name: CELIA_ADMIN_PIN
secrets.scope: staff PIN; environment-scoped so no PR job can read it
secrets.notes: Must satisfy the same rules as Script Properties ADMIN_PIN (>=16 chars, not 2468, not a single repeated character).

validation.hint: optional locally; required for deployment (16+ chars)

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.scope: identifies the OAuth client only; useless without the secret + refresh token
secrets.notes: Not a password by itself, stored as a secret only because it pairs with the client secret and points at the system account's app registration.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.scope: exchanges the refresh token for access tokens; never used by the site or the clinic backend
secrets.notes: Rotating it invalidates every refresh token issued to that client — rotate client secret and profile tokens together.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN_DEV
secrets.scope: dev/test bridge for profile 'dev': Drive drive.file + Sheets + Calendar events. Never contains booking data of real guardians
secrets.notes: One name per profile (google-bridge.md §3). Swapping the account = new profile + new token name, zero code changes. Leak → revoke in the account's permissions, re-run scripts/google/auth.js, update the secret.

validation.hint: starts with 1// — refresh tokens are password-equivalent

secrets.name: PAGES_TOKEN
secrets.provider: owner-created fine-grained PAT (repo: this one only; permission: Pages: read+write, Administration: read+write)
secrets.scope: enable the Pages site once; read/write nothing else. Never used by the deploy step itself
secrets.notes: Optional. Only needed when PAGES_AUTO_ENABLE=true on the first run, because GITHUB_TOKEN cannot create a Pages site. Remove both after Pages exists. Fine-grained PATs cannot be created by an agent — the owner does it.

secrets.name: WAAPI_API_TOKEN
secrets.provider: WAAPI (three-day no-card trial; paid subscription terms unverified)
secrets.scope: manual presence check and read-only instance API; no message sending
secrets.notes: Optional. The manual job checks availability, then sends the token only to WAAPI's fixed read-only instances endpoint; it never prints the token or the response. No WAAPI runtime integration or free paid plan is implied.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_TOKEN
secrets.scope: send appointment notifications only; never read by booking logic, never returned to the browser
secrets.notes: Deliberately referenced by NO workflow: CI runs WhatsApp.gs in off/dry-run and must never need a provider credential. Stays empty until the owner sets it in Script Properties. Declared here so the name has exactly one home (rule 4).

validation.hint: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API token; Script Properties only

variables.name: LLM_PRIMARY
variables.notes: Must exist in Llm.gs LLM.PROVIDERS. Apps Script reads LLM_CHAIN from Script Properties; keep them aligned.

variables.name: LLM_SMOKE_ENABLED
variables.notes: Explicit opt-in: turns a missing secret into a hard failure instead of a skip (useful when rotating).

variables.name: GOOGLE_PROFILE
variables.notes: Selects the active Google profile; the matching refresh-token secret is derived from it.

variables.name: GOOGLE_AUTH_MODE
variables.notes: local | oauth_user | apps_script_bridge | colab_mount. CI always runs local: zero credentials.

variables.name: PAGES_AUTO_ENABLE
variables.notes: true only until the Pages site exists; then delete the variable and the PAGES_TOKEN secret.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_MODE
variables.notes: off | dry-run | live. off is the default and dry-run builds the request without any network call. live is unreachable in CI and stays blocked until the Zero-Card decision is revisited (docs/prd/whatsapp-cloud-api.md).

variables.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
variables.notes: Meta phone-number id used to build the messages endpoint inside WhatsApp.gs. Non-sensitive but provider-specific; Code.gs never sees it. Empty until the owner creates the WhatsApp Business account.

validation.hint: digits only, from the Meta dashboard

variables.name: WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION
variables.notes: Graph API version used to build the messages endpoint. Configurable because Meta publishes no support window for a pinned version; an unparsable value falls back to the default instead of building a nonsense URL. Meta's current examples use v23.0-v27.0 — see docs/free-tiers.json.

forbidden_in_workflows: inline ${{ secrets.X }} inside run: text (must go through env:)

rotation.runbook: 1 revoke at provider → 2 create new key → 3 update GitHub secret + Script Properties → 4 purge from history if committed → 5 record the date in 'rotated'

canonical_places.colab: README colab snippet + scripts/env.js contract; Colab Secrets UI holds values
canonical_places.apps_script: Script Properties (runtime truth for the clinic backend)
canonical_places.google_bridge: config/google.profile.<profile>.json (git-ignored, ids only) + docs/google-setup.md (console steps, names only)

dependabot.rule: Dependabot PR workflows see ONLY Dependabot secrets; duplicate a key there only if a dependency PR must run a live probe — never add production keys

policy_refs.google_bridge: docs/google-setup.md — function→service map, profile swap, retry map, failure actions
